title: History browser unable to display heart rate data in graph
body:
Build version 3.2.0.4, but also in older builds like 3.2.0.3

Though the graph on the main page is capable of retrieving up to 24 hours of heart rate data, the History browser does not seem to be able to display this. Not even on the current day. 
Possibly missed during release of heart rate support.

comments.body: On latest dev I don't have this issue...
